page.layout: One page of text, one column, with marginal notes; a single catchword-free page. Running head at top centre; page number at top right; no notes in the margins; one printed signature line "O. ÿ" at the foot of the text, set right of centre.

main_text.p: Hic Crassum iam grandem in Parthos ire coegit: Castra sequi Niciam, & sonitus audire tubarum: Annibalem Castrensi urbana negotia more Et forti regere imperio, vimque addere iussis: Et iuuenem Phaethonta Deorum innuisse sedes Aethereas, patremque regendos poscere currus: Teq; malos Mauri te duros Choerile versus Condere, & inuitis modulari Carmina Musis.

Longum fit memorare quot & quibus obfuit olim Falsis dissimulata modis infcitia rerum, Vsurpata etiam non vera gloria laudis. Nec vitium in terris proserpere latius ullum Cernitur: imbuti falsis erroribus omnes, Et tumidi bufone magis, ranaque palustri Audemus natura ipsi condicere bella, Qualia terrigenas mouisse est fama Gigantes. Haud procul at Nemesis sedet ultrix dira malorum. Continuo subiti casus variique sequuntur Et rerum & vitae discrimina mille: nec ipsos Authores modo, verum alios quoscunque voluntas Adiunxit, comitesve dedit fortuna, videmus Vna omnes cadere atque inuoluisse ruina: Multas & lugere suis cum civibus urbes: Multa queri male se furioso credita regna. Quod si tum non ille sui deceptus amore, Ausus plus aliquid de se sperare fuisset, Cum caris hodie florens & laetus amicis Integris opibus securum transfigat aevum:

page.notes: Marginal reference mark "*" after "Carmina" and a small "y"-shaped mark near "malorum" are reference marks; no marginal notes printed. The catchword line and signature "O. ÿ" were read with doubt. Heavy ink-smudge at right of "olim" (likely a mark, not text). Several words in the lower half (e.g., "inuoluisse", "sperare") were read with uncertainty; the long s is shown as s throughout. Possible printing error: "Mauri" (read as Mauri/Maui); "Teq;" as printed. Line "Et forti regere imperio" and "Vsurpata" are as read from a slightly skewed scan.
